final_message:
I built the ICF extraction and compliance report (about 6,900 words). It opens and passes the docx validator. The main finding is that ICF v3.0 is not ready for inspection, and the internal FDA checklist is wrong on most of its "Complete" entries. The ICF is missing two required items: the alternatives disclosure (50.25(a)(4)) and the ClinicalTrials.gov statement (50.25(c)). It also leaves out the thyroid tumor Boxed Warning that the protocol requires, lists the old IRB phone number (704) 555-3829 instead of (704) 555-3920, conflicts with the protocol on visits and pay (16 visits, $800 vs. 18 visits, $1,350), and the re-consent deadline of May 20, 2025 was missed (298 of 412 re-consented).
